_doc: DERIVED. Contours for the 'region' scope, built by tools/build-contours.py from USGS 3DEP elevation (rasterFunction None, public domain). Interval 100m minor / 500m major, sampled on a 1024x901 grid, simplified at 0.0008 deg. Elevation range 1278-3596m over 100.0% of the box. Regenerate rather than hand-edit.
